meta.title: Closing the Loop, Building the Memory
meta.subtitle: The thesis on one canvas. Four zones: how the loop runs, how it is governed, what the evidence says, and how the schema enforces it.
meta.author: Elvis Shehi, MSc Responsible AI, OPIT
meta.built: 21 August 2026; wording revised 17 September 2026 to the revision contract
meta.note: Every number here is read from the repository or the revised manuscript. Sources are named on the cards that carry them.

legend: Model reasoning. It appears exactly twice.
Deterministic code. Everything that acts on the outside world.
External system, integrated rather than rebuilt.

zones.title: 1. The governed loop, as it runs
zones.subtitle: Signal in, approved action out, outcome measured against a contract, learning kept and retrieved on the next decision.

nodes.title: Feedback sources
nodes.lede: Five official API pulls, plus CSV and webhook intake.
nodes.note: Zendesk, Trustpilot, App Store, Google Play, Business Profile

nodes.title: Ingestion
nodes.lede: Normalise, de-identify, mask PII.
nodes.note: Near-duplicates are flagged at counting, never dropped

nodes.title: Enrichment
nodes.lede: Model stage one. Six fields per signal.
nodes.note: Carries provenance and a model score, which is not a probability

nodes.title: Synthesis
nodes.lede: Severity from the corroborating set, not the loudest voice.
nodes.note: Urgency, volume, negative proportion

nodes.title: Rule evaluation
nodes.lede: Deterministic. Priority, then specificity, then dedupe.
nodes.note: The rule that won is recorded

nodes.title: Risk gate
nodes.lede: A rule with auto_execute false stops here.
nodes.note: Where that line sits is a value judgement; RQ4 was to test it and was not conducted

nodes.title: Approval interrupt
nodes.lede: A graph interrupt, not a UI confirmation.
nodes.note: Evidence hashed at decision time. Four-eyes available.

nodes.title: Execute
nodes.lede: Two destinations ship: Jira and Slack.
nodes.note: Zendesk is ingest only

nodes.title: External systems
nodes.lede: Real Jira issues and Slack messages.

nodes.title: Outcome contract
nodes.lede: Metric and window, bound to the action at creation.
nodes.note: Fixed before the action runs, so no metric shopping after

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.lede: Scheduled checkpoints decide target attainment over a frozen interval (grade D).
nodes.note: The interrupted-time-series estimate is shown beside them, graded C only when fitted; refuses below 10 pre-days and 5 post-days

nodes.title: Closure, three meanings
nodes.lede: Delivery. Target attainment, measured against a contract. Attributed improvement.
nodes.note: The loop verdict is issued on attainment; attribution is never asserted

nodes.title: Learning store
nodes.lede: Confidence decays by half-life, auditable by query.
nodes.note: Only human-validated conclusions are retrievable

notes.title: Probed, contemporaneous record
notes.lede: a past remedy reaching the new recommendation, once retrieval is on (3 July 2026, GLM-5.2).
notes.note: 6 September: 3 of 3 themes on GLM-5.2, 1 of 4 on the production default

notes.title: Not measured
notes.lede: The outcome data behind those learnings is simulated.
notes.note: Retrieval effect, not benefit; decay is an untested hypothesis.

notes.title: The architectural commitment
notes.lede: Model reasoning appears exactly twice. Everything downstream is testable code.

notes.title: The bound on the gate
notes.lede: routing accuracy with the inventory supplied. The gate controls false positives; it cannot recover escalation-worthy signals ranked too low, 22 of 50 on the production rubric.

notes.title: Where this runs
notes.lede: FastAPI and LangGraph on a Hetzner EU VPS. Vercel. Supabase Postgres. In production since July 2026.
notes.note: Contracts, loop verdicts and learning memory: implemented and tested at September commits, not deployed at the time of writing (§4.1)

bands.label: Action to learning, and back into the next decision

zones.title: 2. Governance, mapped onto the same loop
zones.subtitle: Responsible AI is a property of the loop rather than a module beside it. Each control names the stage it governs.

nodes.title: Article 14, human oversight
nodes.lede: Governs the approval interrupt.
nodes.note: Past the article: friction by risk, evidence shown, per-decision attribution

nodes.title: Article 12, logging
nodes.lede: Governs execution and the audit write.
nodes.note: Rule, parameters, executor, result. Evidence pack hashed.

nodes.title: Article 50, transparency
nodes.lede: Governs anything customer-facing.
nodes.note: Human editorial review is the exemption mechanism

nodes.title: Article 3(39), scope boundary
nodes.lede: Sentiment on text is not emotion recognition.
nodes.note: That definition is biometric. Worth stating before it is asked.

nodes.title: GDPR
nodes.lede: Governs ingestion and storage.
nodes.note: PII masking, retention limits, row-level security in Postgres

nodes.title: Model sovereignty
nodes.lede: Governs both model stages.
nodes.note: Hosted, EU gateway, or self-hosted. A configuration change.

nodes.title: The regulation moved under the build
nodes.lede: Annex III duties moved to Dec 2027. Article 50 stayed on Aug 2026.
nodes.note: The argument for durable commitments over date-triggered features

nodes.title: Governance of the research itself
nodes.lede: The consent form tells participants the interviewer built the prototype. The study was not conducted.
nodes.note: Fourth consent checkbox. No commercial follow-up for six months.

nodes.title: Ingestion authenticity review
nodes.lede: Governs what enters the loop: provenance, duplication, bursts, batch uniformity.
nodes.note: Annotates, never drops. Abstains under ten words. Reports its own flag rate per language

nodes.title: The capability it refuses
nodes.lede: Per-comment AI authorship is not implemented, on measured grounds.
nodes.note: The refusal is the control. Evidence in zone 3, method in docs/engineering/ai-verbatim-detection.md

notes.title: The checker is advisory
notes.lede: An approval gate, an audit log, an advisory checker. Not a policy engine.

notes.title: Row-level security has a limit
notes.lede: Not warranted against adversarial co-tenants. Pilots run single-workspace.

notes.title: Model score is a label, not a calibration
notes.lede: Named as a label, not measured as a probability. It orders cases without warranting one.

notes.title: The lesson that keeps recurring
notes.lede: A declared control is not an enforced control until somebody checks it.
notes.note: Platform in July, method in August, manuscript last week

zones.title: 3. The evidence map
zones.subtitle: Every claim, its status in the vocabulary of §1.7, and the file that produced it. A status is stated once and every chapter has to agree with it.

nodes.title: The thesis corpus
nodes.lede: real public signals, paraphrased and de-identified.
nodes.note: Fintech 67, food delivery 82, B2B 39. Source language EN 102, DE 84.

nodes.title: The in-repo golden set, kept apart
nodes.lede: curated bilingual cases: a development and validation benchmark co-developed with the artifact, not independent confirmation.
nodes.note: GLM-5.2 snapshot 99% sentiment, 91% urgency. A different gold, so never merged in.

nodes.title: Held out on purpose
nodes.lede: held outside the corpus: Vodafone 65, Delivery Hero 86, banks 104.
nodes.note: Draft labels. The corpus is still 188.

nodes.title: Result 1. Triage accuracy depends on the method
nodes.lede: The generic prompt's sentiment lead over TF-IDF is stable across repeated runs on the same items and not significant after the retrospective Holm correction (0.174). On risk the two are not distinguishable on this corpus (0.644).
nodes.note: Status: measured (bounded). One retrospective Holm family of ten comparisons per task; only the floor comparisons survive on sentiment

nodes.title: Result 2. Whose problems reach a human
nodes.lede: TF-IDF and the generic prompt are not distinguishable on risk accuracy on this corpus; their stratum recalls are descriptive figures on eight items. The production stage escalates 28 of 50 positives on either model.
nodes.note: Status: descriptive. German-source stratum n = 8; within-predictor Fisher tests (0.026 and 1.0) do not rank the predictors; no language effect, no parity.

nodes.title: Result 3. Routing
nodes.lede: journey stage over 27 classes, owner over 51, against floors of 0.20 and 0.15; n = 182.
nodes.note: Inventory supplied: a constrained task, not a bound on free-form routing. On classes with at least five examples, macro-F1 0.55 and 0.42.

nodes.title: Result 4. The learning memory
nodes.lede: a past remedy reaching the new recommendation on GLM-5.2 (3 July 2026, contemporaneous record); 6 September: 3 of 3 themes on GLM-5.2, 1 of 4 on the production default.
nodes.note: The outcomes behind it are simulated; decay (DP2) is an untested hypothesis

nodes.title: What is still open
nodes.lede: DP1 implemented and tested on simulated outcome data. DP2 an untested hypothesis. One kappa, provenance unverified. RQ4 not conducted.
nodes.note: Kappa 0.55 (0.70 weighted) on 40 risk items: second-rating agreement with independent human provenance unverified, never used as human validation (Appendix G.1). RQ4: protocol, instruments and pre-registered tiers retained (Appendix A; §5B)

notes.lede: Texts are English paraphrases, so every per-language result is a source-language stratum.

zones.title: 4. The schema is the argument
zones.subtitle: The thesis's two primitives are tables with foreign keys rather than prose. Closure is referential integrity, and memory is a column that decays.

nodes.title: signals
nodes.lede: Raw feedback plus its enrichment.

nodes.title: problems
nodes.lede: Signals grouped, with cross-signal severity and a reach basis.

nodes.title: rules
nodes.lede: Priority, specificity, action type, auto_execute.

nodes.title: actions_log
nodes.lede: One immutable row per action.

nodes.title: approval_records
nodes.lede: Reviewer from the verified login. Evidence sha256 at decision time.

nodes.title: outcome_contracts
nodes.lede: One to one with the action, created with it.

nodes.title: outcome_measurements
nodes.lede: Each checkpoint reading carries its grade (D, E if manual; the fitted estimate C), provenance stamped server-side.

nodes.title: ab_learnings
nodes.lede: base_confidence and half_life_days. Decay is a column.

nodes.title: taxonomy_nodes
nodes.lede: Themes carrying the same decay fields.

notes.title: Why this matters
notes.lede: An action cannot exist without a contract. Closed is a row with evidence, not a flag.

notes.title: Tenancy
notes.lede: Workspace-scoped, enforced in Postgres below the application layer.

notes.title: One store contract
notes.lede: jsonb payloads with promoted columns. SQLite, in-memory, Postgres.

notes.title: The same discipline, one layer up
notes.lede: One shared status function, so the dashboard numbers reconcile by construction.

notes.title: What the schema does not yet carry
notes.lede: Evidence grade B, the controlled quasi-experiment, has never been produced.
